sections.title: WI/MI THROUGH THIS EVENING
sections.text: A SERIES OF LOW-AMPLITUDE SPEED MAXIMA WILL EJECT EWD/ENEWD FROM ND/MN OVER NRN WI/UPPER MI BY THIS EVENING...WHILE AN UPSTREAM TROUGH AMPLIFIES OVER THE NRN ROCKIES/NRN HIGH PLAINS TONIGHT. MEANWHILE...A WEAKENING OVERNIGHT MCS CONTINUES TO MOVE EWD FROM WI TO W CENTRAL LOWER MI. A TRAILING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY HAS ALREADY BEGUN TO RETREAT NWD ACROSS SRN/CENTRAL WI THIS MORNING...IN ADVANCE OF A DIFFUSE SURFACE COLD FRONT MOVING INTO MN. BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS OF 65-70 F ARE COMMON S OF THE OUTFLOW ACROSS SRN WI/SRN MN/IA...AND THIS MOISTURE WILL SPREAD NEWD TODAY ACROSS WI TOWARD WRN UPPER MI IN THE WAKE OF THE MORNING STORMS. THE MOISTENING WILL OCCUR BENEATH NEWD EXTENSION OF A REMNANT PLUME OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...SUCH THAT DAYTIME HEATING WILL RESULT IN STRONG INSTABILITY ALONG THE SURFACE COLD FRONT AND RETREATING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. STORM INITIATION WILL BE MOST PROBABLE ACROSS CENTRAL/NE WI BY EARLY-MID AFTERNOON AS THE LOW LEVELS DESTABILIZE AND THIS AREA IS BRUSHED BY THE BAND OF ASCENT NOW OVERSPREADING CENTRAL/NE MN. THUS...STORM INITIATION IS EXPECTED PRIOR TO THE COMMENCEMENT OF HEIGHT RISES AS THE MIDLEVEL TROUGH MOVES TOWARD UPPER MI/ONTARIO...AND SHORTWAVE RID

sections.title: NE SD/SW MN/EXTREME SE ND LATE TONIGHT
sections.text: A SURFACE COLD FRONT WILL STALL THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING NEAR THE NEB/SD AND MN/IA BORDERS. STRONG INSTABILITY WILL BE PRESENT ACROSS IA/NEB TO THE S OF THE BOUNDARY...BUT SURFACE-BASED STORM INITIATION ALONG THE FRONT WILL LIKELY BE INHIBITED BY THE NRN EXTENT OF A VERY WARM ELEVATED MIXED LAYER. INSTEAD...ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS WILL BECOME MORE PROBABLE OVERNIGHT ACROSS ERN SD/SW MN/SE ND TO THE N OF THE WARM FRONT...IN THE ZONE OF STRONGEST LOW-LEVEL WAA ON THE NOSE OF A 50 KT LLJ. HERE...CONVECTION ROOTED IN THE 850-700 MB LAYER WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE LARGE HAIL GIVEN MUCAPE AOA 1500-2000 J/KG...STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IN EXCESS OF 40 KT.

sections.title: UPPER OH VALLEY TODAY
sections.text: A MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT /PER THE 12Z ILN SOUNDING/ IS EXPECTED ACROSS THE UPPER OH VALLEY REGION TODAY. THOUGH VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE WEAK...INSTABILITY SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR ISOLATED DOWNBURSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS THIS AFTERNOON. ..THOMPSON/SMITH.. 06/18/2012

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PARTS OF WI AND MI
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PORTIONS OF SD AND NORTHERN NEB...

sections.title: WI/MI
sections.text: A LARGE UPPER RIDGE IS PRESENT TODAY OVER MOST OF THE CENTRAL/SOUTHERN UNITED STATES...WHILE THE PRIMARY BAND OF WESTERLIES ALOFT EXTENDS FROM THE PACIFIC NORTHWEST ACROSS THE NORTHERN PLAINS INTO THE GREAT LAKES REGION. ONE SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS EVIDENT OVER SOUTHERN MANITOBA/MN. THIS FEATURE WILL TRACK EASTWARD ACROSS PARTS OF WI/UPPER MI LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. MUCH OF THIS AREA HAS BEEN AFFECTED BY AN OVERNIGHT MCS NOW OVER LOWER MI. HOWEVER...RECENT SURFACE ANALYSES SHOW LOW LEVEL MOISTURE RAPIDLY SPREADING NORTHWARD ACROSS WI WITH UPPER 60S DEWPOINTS NOW INTO THE RHI AREA. CLOUDS WILL SLOW HEATING/ DESTABILIZATION IN THIS REGION...BUT AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES SHOULD REACH 2000 J/KG WITH ONLY WEAK CAPPING REMAINING. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT THUNDERSTORMS WILL INTENSIFY THIS AFTERNOON OVER NORTHERN AND CENTRAL WI AS THE TAIL-END OF THE LARGE SCALE ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH THE UPPER TROUGH AFFECTS THE REGION. MODERATE CAPE VALUES AND FAVORABLE VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES WILL PROMOTE A RISK OF SUPERCELLS AND BOW STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS...LARGE HAIL...AND ISOLATED TORNADOES. THESE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO SPREAD EASTWARD INTO PARTS OF UPPER MI AND LAKE MI DURING T

sections.title: SD/MN TONIGHT
sections.text: MODELS SUGGEST THAT AN INTENSE LOW LEVEL JET WILL DEVELOP THIS EVENING OVER THE CENTRAL PLAINS. STRONG LOW LEVEL WARM ADVECTION AND DESTABILIZATION IS EXPECTED ACROSS PARTS OF SD AND NORTHERN NEB...LEADING TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. MODEL FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW AMPLE CAPE AND VERTICAL SHEAR FOR SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL.

sections.title: OH VALLEY
sections.text: A PLUME OF LOW/MID LEVEL MOISTURE EXTENDS ACROSS THE MID/UPPER OH VALLEY WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S. BROKEN CLOUDS WILL SOMEWHAT HINDER DAYTIME HEATING...BUT SUFFICIENT DESTABILIZATION IS EXPECTED FOR SCATTERED AFTERNOON THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT. WEAK MID LEVEL WINDS WILL LIMIT CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION...BUT ISOLATED CELLS MAY PRODUCE LOCALLY GUSTY WINDS AND HAIL. ..HART/MOSIER.. 06/18/2012

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS PARTS OF WI AND MI
sections.text: ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PORTIONS OF SD...SWRN MN AND EXTREME NRN NEB... ...THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PORTIONS OF NRN AND CENTAL OH... HAVE INTRODUCED A SMALL CATEGORICAL SLGT RISK OVER NRN/CENTRAL OH FOR ON-GOING CLUSTER OF STG/SVR STORMS THAT SHOULD CONTINUE TO POSE A RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS/LARGE HAIL THROUGH REMAINDER OF AFTN/EARLY EVENING. MODEST DEEP-LAYER SHEAR OF 25-30 KT COMBINED WITH MLCAPE OF 1500 J/KG AND STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUGGESTS FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT FOR CLUSTER OF STORMS AS IT MOVES E/SEWD. ADDED 5 PERCENT SVR WIND PROBABILITIES ACROSS S TX WHERE COMBINATION OF WEAK SWWD PROPAGATING MID-LEVEL CIRCULATION AND STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUGGESTS ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS ARE POSSIBLE THROUGH REMAINDER OF THIS AFTN. REF MCD #1208 FOR THE LATEST SHORT-TERM TRENDS FOR ON-GOING SVR TSTMS OVER WI. OTHERWISE...PREVIOUS REMAINS ON TRACK FOR REMAINDER OF CONUS. ..BUNTING.. 06/18/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1049 AM CDT MON JUN 18 2012/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LONG-LIVED MCS SHOULD POSE A RISK OF DAMAGING WIND AS DOWNSTREAM SURFACE HEATING CONTINUES...BUT OBSERVATIONAL TRENDS LARGELY SUGGEST ACTIVITY HAS BEEN WEAKENING AND MAY REMAIN ONLY LOCALLY/MARGINALLY SEVERE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG MEASURED WIND GUSTS WITH SPORADIC WIND DAMAGE REPORTS HAVE OCCURRED IN THE PAST HOUR ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF SHORT-LINE SEGMENT /NOW FROM SAGINAW TO BARRY COUNTIES/. HOWEVER...CLOUD TOP TEMPERATURES HAVE BEEN WARMING WITH THIS MCS AND LITTLE INCREASE IN DEEP-LAYER FLOW WAS NOTED IN THE GRR VWP DATA AFTER PASSAGE OF THE LINE. WHILE FARTHER DOWNSTREAM INSTABILITY IS LIMITED PER MODIFIED 12Z DTX RAOB... CONVECTION MAY CONTINUE TO BE RENEWED ALONG THE SWRN FLANK OF THE SEGMENT AS IT INTERCEPTS THE FRINGE OF MIDDLE 60S SURFACE DEW POINTS. THIS SUGGESTS OVERALL ORIENTATION MAY BECOME MORE W/E WITH TIME AND MITIGATE A MORE ROBUST INCREASE IN SEVERE POTENTIAL THROUGH EARLY AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE POTENTIAL WILL INCREASE WITH BOTH A CLUSTER OF TSTMS ALONG THE WI/MI BORDER AND ADDITIONAL TSTMS LIKELY FORMING ALONG A SW/NE-ORIENTED PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE BAND. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL BE HIGHLY FAVORABLE FOR INITIAL SUPERCELLS AND EVENTUAL UPSCALE GROWTH INTO AN MCS WITH BOWING SEGMENTS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CU HAS INCREASED ALONG A PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE BAND SEEN IN VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY FROM AROUND 30 S MSP TO 45 NE EAU IN THE WAKE OF PROBABLE ELEVATED CONVECTION ALONG THE WI/MI BORDER. AIR MASS IS STRONGLY DESTABILIZING IN BETWEEN THESE TWO FEATURES WITH MLCAPE NEARING 2000 J/KG AND WEAKENING MLCIN. GIVEN THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY IN WI...IT APPEARS LIKELY THAT AT LEAST ISOLATED TSTMS SHOULD FORM ALONG THE CONFLUENCE BAND BY 18-19Z. WITH 50-60 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR AND DEEP-LAYER FLOW LARGELY PARALLELING THE INITIATING BOUNDARY...INITIAL SUPERCELLS SHOULD QUICKLY GROW UPSCALE WITH EMBEDDED BOWING STRUCTURES. ALTHOUGH LOW-LEVEL FLOW IS LARGELY VEERED IN THE WARM SECTOR...AN ISOLATED TORNADO OR TWO IS POSSIBLE IN NERN WI WHERE FLOW SHOULD REMAIN MORE BACKED. OTHERWISE...SEVERE WIND/HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY RISKS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS MOVING SE ACROSS SERN MI WILL POSE A THREAT FOR ISOLATED SEVERE WIND/HAIL AS IT MOVES THROUGH N-CNTRL OH DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED AND A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME. HOWEVER...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED CLOSELY FOR SIGNS OF ORGANIZATION/STRENGTHENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINE OF TSTMS MOVING SE ACROSS SERN MI WILL MOVE INTO A MORE UNSTABLE AIR MASS ACROSS N-CNTRL OH DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. LATEST SPC MESOANALYSIS SUGGESTS MLCAPE AOA 1000 J/KG AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR NEAR 20 KTS ACROSS THE AREA. THIS SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR A FEW STRONG UPDRAFTS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING HAIL. ADDITIONALLY...SURFACE ANALYSIS DEPICTS A WEAK BOUNDARY ACROSS FAR N-CNTRL OH SEPARATING SURFACE TEMPERATURES IN THE MID 80S AND DEWPOINT IN THE UPPER 60S FROM SURFACE TEMPERATURES IN THE MID 70S AND DEWPOINTS IN THE LOW 60S. THIS BOUNDARY MAY ACT TO ENHANCE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR AND AID IN STRONG UPDRAFT DEVELOPMENT. ONE CONDITION NOT FAVORING A CONTINUED SEVERE THREAT IS THAT THE CURRENT LINE OF TSTMS IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY DISLOCATED FROM THE STRONG MID-LEVEL FLOW /WHICH REMAINS TO THE NW ACROSS MI/...REDUCING THE OVERALL SEVERE WIND THREAT. CONSEQUENTLY...THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN ISOLATED AND A WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME. HOWEVER...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED CLOSELY FOR SIGNS OF ORGANIZATION/STRENGTHENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PORTIONS OF WW 406 CENTERED OVER NERN WI ARE BEING CONSIDERED FOR REPLACEMENT WITH A TORNADO WATCH. THIS MAY BE REQUIRED IF MORE INTENSE/SUSTAINED SUPERCELLS BECOME NOTED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SEVERAL SEMI-DISCRETE CELLS WERE PREVALENT WITHIN A WSW/ENE-ORIENTED PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENT BAND FROM 40 W CWA TO NEAR ESC. REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/COMPOSITE WARM FRONT INTERSECTS THIS ACTIVITY FROM MARATHON TO SHEBOYGAN COUNTIES. ALTHOUGH THE HODOGRAPH IS FAIRLY STRAIGHT-LINE...STRONG LOW-LEVEL SPEED SHEAR REMAINS NEAR THIS JUXTAPOSITION /AROUND 35 KT FROM 0-1 KM IN THE GRB VWP DATA/. ADDITIONAL SHOWERS FORMING S OF THE ONGOING ACTIVITY WOULD LIKELY POSE THE GREATEST RISK FOR DEVELOPING SUSTAINED LOW-LEVEL MESOCYCLONES...WHICH MAY BE SUFFICIENT FOR A TORNADO THREAT DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ..GRAMS.. 06/18/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DOWNSTREAM WW ISSUANCE WILL BE CONSIDERED IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS AS MCS OVER NERN WI/ERN UPPER MI IS EXTRAPOLATED TO REACH NRN LOWER MI BETWEEN 23-00Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: IN THE WAKE OF EARLIER CONVECTIVE DEBRIS...NEARLY CLOUD-FREE SKIES HAS RESULTED IN STRONG HEATING WITH TEMPERATURES WARMING GENERALLY THROUGH THE 80S IN LOWER MI. ALTHOUGH BUOYANCY IS LIKELY NOT AS GREAT AS W OF LK MI GIVEN THE OVERTURNING EARLIER THIS MORNING...CONTINUED HEATING MAY SUPPORT ONGOING ACTIVITY BEING SUSTAINED AS IT CROSS THE LK INTO NRN LOWER MI. PRIMARY RISK SHOULD BE DAMAGING WIND AS STRONG UNIDIRECTIONAL DEEP-LAYER SHEAR MAY YIELD BOWING LINE SEGMENTS. ..GRAMS.. 06/18/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOW RISK FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND HAIL MAY CONTINUE WITH SOUTHWARD ADVANCING CLUSTER OF STORMS THRU MID EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ALTHOUGH SOME FLUCTUATIONS IN INTENSITY HAVE BEEN OBSERVED...THE SMALL BUT ORGANIZED MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM IS MAINTAINING INTENSITY AS IT APPROACHES ZANESVILLE AND ADJACENT AREAS OF SOUTHEASTERN OHIO. MODEST SOUTHERLY INFLOW OF MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AIR /LIKELY WITH CAPE ON THE ORDER OF 1000-1500+ J PER KG/ IS SUPPORTING ACTIVITY...WHICH MAY NOT WEAKEN FOR AT LEAST ANOTHER FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...LITTLE IS SUGGESTIVE TO INDICATE SUBSTANTIVE FURTHER INTENSIFICATION. SEVERE POTENTIAL STILL APPEARS SOMEWHAT LOW...BUT OCCASIONAL MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALIZED WIND GUSTS APPROACHING OR BRIEFLY EXCEEDING SEVERE LIMITS MAY PERSIST AS ACTIVITY PROPAGATES SOUTHWARD AROUND 25-30 KTS...ACROSS THE OHIO RIVER INTO PARTS OF WEST VIRGINIA THROUGH 00-02Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR WEATHER THREAT CONTINUES FOR WW 406.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD AT UP TO 40 KT ACROSS ERN WI. SWLY LOW-LEVEL TRAJECTORIES CONTINUE TO MAINTAIN A FEED OF MOIST/UNSTABLE AIR TO THIS ACTIVITY...WHILE STRONG DEEP-LAYER WLY WIND FIELDS SUPPORT ORGANIZED CONVECTION POSING A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS/LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS AN ISOLATED TORNADO. AS ONGOING ACTIVITY MOVES OFFSHORE ACROSS LK MI...ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG TRAILING AGITATED CUMULUS FIELD IS UNCERTAIN GIVEN SUBSIDENT LARGE-SCALE REGIME BEHIND UPPER SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THEREFORE...CONTINUED CLEARANCE OF COUNTIES FROM WW 406 BEHIND DEPARTING CONVECTION MAY BE JUSTIFIED. ..GARNER.. 06/18/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THERE APPEARS LOW POTENTIAL FOR SEVERE HAIL AND WIND WITH CONVECTION DEVELOPING EAST SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS NORTHWESTERN AND WEST CENTRAL NORTH DAKOTA THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...DUE TO THE ANTICIPATED ISOLATED/MARGINAL NATURE OF THE THREAT...A WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST WDSS-II MESH DATA SUGGEST THAT ISOLATED VIGOROUS STORM DEVELOPMENT NOW APPROACHING THE WILLISTON AREA COULD BE PRODUCING SEVERE HAIL. FORCING FOR ACTIVITY IS A BIT UNCLEAR...BUT WESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW IS CONTRIBUTING TO PROPAGATION WITHIN A MOIST POST-COLD FRONTAL CORRIDOR WITH THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES THAT MAY BE CHARACTERIZED BY STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND CAPE IN EXCESS OF 500 J/KG. THIS AXIS EXTENDS ACROSS THE WILLISTON AREA INTO THE VICINITY OF GARRISON...AND PROBABLY WILL REMAIN THE FOCUS FOR STORM PROPAGATION THROUGH 01-03Z. THE NORTHERLY AND WESTERLY COMPONENT TO THE LOW-LEVEL POST-FRONTAL FLOW FIELD IS NOT OPTIMAL ...BUT...WITH EASTWARD EXTENT ACROSS NORTHWESTERN INTO CENTRAL NORTH DAKOTA...WESTERLY 500 MB FLOW DOES STRENGTHEN FROM 35 TO 50 KTS. AS STORMS MOVE INTO A MORE STRONGLY SHEARED REGIME...SOME INCREASE IN ORGANIZATION AND INTENSITY APPEARS POSSIBLE PRIOR TO THE ONSET OF BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING LATER THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: UNCERTAINTY LINGERS CONCERNING THE INITIATION OF STORM DEVELOPMENT THIS EVENING. BUT ONCE IT BECOMES MORE CERTAIN...A WW WILL PROBABLY BE NEEDED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A PLUME OF VERY WARM ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR...WHICH HAS ADVECTED OFF THE PLATEAU REGION THROUGH MUCH OF THE SOUTHERN AND CENTRAL PLAINS AND MIDDLE MISSOURI VALLEY REGION...CONTINUES TO PROVIDE STRONG INHIBITION TO CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT SOUTH OF THE SOUTHERN SOUTH DAKOTA AND SOUTHERN MINNESOTA STATE BORDERS. THE LOWER AND MID-LEVEL THERMAL GRADIENT IS SHARP ALONG THE NORTHERN PERIPHERY OF THIS PLUME...WHERE CONVERGENCE AND WARM ADVECTION ARE EXPECTED TO STRENGTHEN SUBSTANTIALLY THROUGH THE 03-06Z TIME FRAME. GUIDANCE CONTINUES TO INDICATE THAT THIS WILL OCCUR WITH SOUTH SOUTHWESTERLY 850 MB JET STRENGTHENING IN EXCESS OF 50 KT ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS. THE ENVIRONMENT REMAINS RELATIVELY DRY ACROSS MUCH OF THE DAKOTAS AND MINNESOTA...BUT HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT AIR IS PRESENT ALONG AND SOUTH OF A REMNANT CONVECTIVELY GENERATED OR ENHANCED BOUNDARY EXTENDING ACROSS SOUTHERN MINNESOTA AND NORTHWEST IOWA INTO NORTHERN NEBRASKA. THIS BOUNDARY HAS ALREADY BEGUN TO LIFT NORTHWARD THROUGH THE MID MISSOURI VALLEY...WITH RAPID SURFACE DEW POINT INCREASES INTO THE UPPER 60S/NEAR 70F OBSERVED OVER SOUTHEASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA DURING THE PAST FEW HOURS. UNCERTAINTY LINGERS CONCERNING LOCATION OF CONVECTIVE INITIATION THIS EVENING...BUT SOME GUIDANCE HAS BEEN SUGGESTIVE THAT BOUNDARY LAYER BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT MAY NOT BE OUT OF THE QUESTION BY 03-04Z ACROSS THE YANKTON/SIOUX FALLS AREA. OTHERWISE...POTENTIAL FOR VIGOROUS CONVECTION ROOTED ABOVE THE BOUNDARY LAYER APPEARS MORE LIKELY ACROSS AREAS OF SOUTHEASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA AND SOUTHERN MINNESOTA...A BIT FARTHER TO THE NORTHEAST. WITH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES SUPPORTING SIZABLE CAPE IN THE PRESENCE STRONG SHEAR BENEATH 50-70 KT WESTERLY 500 MB FLOW...SEVERE STORMS...INCLUDING A FEW SUPERCELLS APPEAR PROBABLY ONCE ACTIVITY INITIAT

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR LARGE HAIL...AND PERHAPS DAMAGING WINDS...MAY CONTINUE TO INCREASE ACROSS THE WW AREA THROUGH 06-07.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VIGOROUS STORM DEVELOPMENT IS NOW WELL UNDERWAY. ACTIVITY BASED WITHIN STRONGER LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WARM ADVECTION NORTHEAST OF HURON...TO THE NORTH OF MORE STRONGLY CAPPING ELEVATED MIXED LAYER AIR...MAY CONTINUE TO SLOWLY INTENSIFY AS IT DEVELOPS EAST NORTHEASTWARD INTO AREAS NORTH THROUGH NORTHEAST OF REDWOOD FALLS BETWEEN NOW AND 06-07Z. ALTHOUGH THIS APPEARS TO BE WELL NORTH OF THE STRONGER LOW-LEVEL JET...IT DOES NOT APPEAR OUT OF THE QUESTION THAT SIZABLE SUB-CLOUD TEMPERATURE-DEW POINT SPREADS COULD SUPPORT ONE OR TWO DOWNBURSTS AND STRONG SURFACE GUSTS...IN ADDITION TO THE CONTINUING RISK FOR LARGE HAIL. TO THE WEST...IT APPEARS THAT NORTHWARD ADVECTION OF THE CAPPING ELEVATED MIXED LAYER MAY SUPPRESS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS MUCH OF SOUTHERN AND CENTRAL SOUTH DAKOTA...BUT INCREASING STRONG/SEVERE STORM DEVELOPMENT STILL APPEARS POSSIBLE ALONG ITS NORTHERN PERIPHERY...WEST THROUGH EAST OF ABERDEEN. ..KERR.. 06/19/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A NEW SEVERE TSTM WATCH WILL BE COORDINATED TO THE EAST OF WW 408 AS ONGOING STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ACROSS THE CURRENT WATCH ARE EXPECTED TO PROGRESS EWD...AND CONTINUE TO POSE A THREAT FOR MAINLY LARGE HAIL...THOUGH STRONG WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. THE PROBABILITY OF NEW WATCH ISSUANCE IS 95 PERCENT. LOCAL WFO EXTENSION OF WW 408 IS POSSIBLE ACROSS NERN SD INTO WEST CENTRAL MN AS SEVERAL STRONGER STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO AFFECT THESE AREAS AFTER 09Z WHERE STRONG BULK SHEAR AND STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL FAVOR MAINLY A HAIL THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SUPERCELL THAT HAS A HISTORY OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL ACROSS EAST CENTRAL SD INTO SWRN MN APPEARS...PER RADAR IMAGERY...TO BE EVOLVING INTO A LINEAR STRUCTURE WITH ADDITIONAL ACTIVITY TO ITS NORTH. AT 0710Z...RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED THIS LINE OF STORMS EXTENDING FROM THE MN COUNTIES OF SRN CHIPPEWA TO WRN REDWOOD/ERN LYON...AND TRACKING EWD AT 35 KT. THIS TRACK TAKES THE STORMS ACROSS THE TWIN CITIES METRO BETWEEN 09-11Z AND SHOULD REACH THE WI COUNTIES OF PRICE TO CLARK BY 13-14Z. THIS SCENARIO IS SUPPORTED BY THE 00Z 4KM NMM/NSSL ARW AND RECENT RUNS OF THE HRRR. THUS FAR...THE ONGOING STORMS...NOW LOCATED OVER SWRN INTO CENTRAL MN WITH ADDITIONAL ACTIVITY AFFECTING MUCH OF NERN SD HAVE REMAINED N OF A WARM FRONT WHICH AT 07Z EXTENDED ENEWD FROM PIPESTONE COUNTY MN TO WABASHA COUNTY AND THEN INTO CENTRAL TO NERN WI. THIS BOUNDARY WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE NWD THROUGH THIS MORNING...AND EFFECTIVELY SHIFTING THE TRACK OF THE STORMS MORE TOWARD THE ENE. STRONG LOW LEVEL WAA IS WELL UNDERWAY ACROSS ERN SD INTO MUCH OF SRN MN WITHIN THE NOSE OF 50 KT SWLY LLJ EXTENDING INTO THIS REGION FROM THE CENTRAL PLAINS. THIS IS AIDING IN DEEP ASCENT WHEN COMBINED WITH UVVS WITHIN THE ENTRANCE REGION OF A 100+ KT 300 MB JET CURRENTLY OVER NRN MN AND ADJACENT ONTARIO. THIS COMBINED WITH A PLUME OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /8-9 C PER KM/ SPREADING ENEWD ACROSS SRN MN INTO CENTRAL WI...AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 50-60 KT WILL FAVOR SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL...SOME VERY LARGE. GIVEN THE LINEAR STRUCTURE EVOLVING OVER SWRN MN...AN INCREASE IN DAMAGING WINDS MAY BE UNDERWAY AS WELL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WINDS REMAIN A THREAT AS A FAST MOVING...BOWING LINE OF STORMS SPREADS ACROSS THE TWIN CITIES METRO THROUGH 0930Z AND INTO WEST CENTRAL WI THROUGH 10-1030Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...ATTENDANT TO TSTMS THAT MOVED THROUGH EAST CENTRAL MN /HENNEPIN TO WASHINGTON COUNTIES/ BETWEEN 08-0845Z...EXTENDED AT 09Z FROM SRN ST CROIX COUNTY WI SWWD THROUGH SRN DAKOTA TO NRN RICE COUNTIES MN. MEANWHILE...BETWEEN 0830-09Z A LINE OF STORMS BEGAN TO ACCELERATE/FORWARD PROPAGATE ENEWD FROM MCLEOD/SIBLEY COUNTIES AS THEY APPEARED TO BE AIDED BY THE AFOREMENTIONED SW-NE EXTENDING OUTFLOW. THE FORWARD SPEED SHOULD PERSIST INTO AT LEAST WEST CENTRAL WI THROUGH 1030Z AS MODERATE INSTABILITY IS FED INTO THIS MCS BY A 50 KT SWLY LLJ EXTENDING INTO SRN MN. ..PETERS.. 06/19/2012
